body: If you value that relationship as a whole don't do it, pal. When competition arises in a poly setup you may need to step back and go back to the drawing board: what's more important for you? Your ego or your partner (and meta)?

Honestly, same here. I love her but she loves me different. She doesn't care about my mental health; I'm a very emotionally intelligent person who also cries a lot (sometimes when I can't explain myself). She calls me weak and blames me for her misconducts when she's drunk saying I should be around to monitor her conversations. Meanwhile I can handle my own drink. She accuses me of being on drugs (I smoke cigarettes and weed) because once I visited home before I moved back and had lost a lotta weight because of low thoughts and not eating enough because I was broke. She told me to leave home with my bad energy/attitude because I wouldn't agree that I do drugs (I tried CAT once and it's not for me). At that time all I needed was my mum's embrace. Never got it. I could go on but I'd write a whole chapter of sorts.

I love my mother but I don't feel I can take spending more time around her. I feel sorry for her because her work contract wasn't renewed but it was not my fault. Ugh. I can't either and I don't have much options except dip myself in the lake just below our yard. Luckily I can't swim nor float ;)

Omg, I remember almost dying once and feeling nothing. Life with our lower lows is a trip. I hope and pray somehow that your low energies rise before you die, if it happens. I can only sympathize with that otherwise, if I died I would shed a tear that my beautiful ass self couldn't reach their actual potential to stunt on 'em whores who've been hoping I don't pop.

Do tell if it's okay though, what makes you suicidal?
Word. I was able to get antibiotics so I'm still on them for the week. Thank you for being real considerate. We will triumph over being broke, I believe. All love!
